g.text: 9 — Atlas asset structure: V5 (frozen) vs V7 (target)

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: V7's fingerprint must cover every behaviour-determining layer, not only the projection basis.

g.text: WHY THE V5 SCHEME DOES NOT GENERALISE

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: V5 hashes ONLY the NMF basis. That was adequate because the basis effectively WAS the atlas —

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: the overlay layers were thin, curated, and separately versioned.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: It is not adequate for V7: an atlas with an identical CSM basis but a different S produces different BSVs,

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: so a basis-only fingerprint would make two behaviourally different atlases indistinguishable.
